# AI Engineering Journal - Participant name

Maintain at least one entry per week and at least ten entries in total. At least three entries must analyse genuine output that was wrong, insecure, outdated, or over-engineered and explain how it was detected. Never fabricate a failure or activity.

## Entry: YYYY-MM-DD - Work item - Package or requirement

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Date and work item | |
| Tool and mode | Chat, inline completion, agent mode, coding agent, code review, or other |
| Goal | |
| Approach and context | Prompt approach and the repository/specification context supplied |
| Outcome | Accepted, modified, or rejected - and why |
| Verification | Tests, review, documentation, or measurements |
| What went wrong or was risky | Record genuine issues only; never fabricate one |
| Time impact | Estimated time saved or lost |
